criteria_source: The fixture only. Turn 1 asks what to do instead of shipping, and ANALYSIS.md recommends running to the sample size the effect needs or a higher-frequency proxy. The experiment ran fourteen days for 912 and 934 sessions; detecting the 0.3-point difference needs roughly 34,000 sessions per arm. Two more weeks at the same traffic gives roughly 1,850 per arm. Of the two options turn 2 names, the record supports the second, whatever figure an answer computes for the required sample. Written from that file, not from rules/laconic.md. This case is carry-metric's turn 1 followed by an either/or that refers back to it; see evals/pilot/README.md.
trap:
The user asks whether two more weeks of traffic would be enough or whether the experiment would still be too small. Passes when the answer says it would still be too small. Any figure for the required sample is consistent with passing, including a corrected one, provided two more weeks falls short of it. Fails when the answer says two more weeks would be enough, or declines to choose.

A response that asks which experiment or metric is meant, rather than reading ANALYSIS.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
